I wrote this list from memory and didn't open the links to check them, so spot-check any URL before you rely on it. Some links point to an engineering blog post and others to the company's open-source repo.

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora, the HTTP proxy that handles much of its edge traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Rewrote its Read States service from Go to Rust", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "Sync engine (Nucleus) and file storage components", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, S3 and EC2 components, Bottlerocket", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming, including Windows components and Azure services", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform components", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Server-side services, source control backend and tooling", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2022/07/27/developer-tools/programming-languages-endorsed-for-server-side-use-at-meta/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Firefox's Stylo CSS engine and other browser components", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/08/inside-a-super-fast-css-engine-quantum-css-aka-stylo/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer syncing server for real-time collaboration", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "npm, Inc.", "use": "Registry authorization service", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Lucet WebAssembly runtime for edge compute", "source": "https://www.fastly.com/blog/announcing-lucet-fastly-native-webassembly-compiler-runtime"},
  {"company": "1Password", "use": "Shared core of its desktop and mobile apps", "source": "https://blog.1password.com/1password-8-the-story-so-far/"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Hubris embedded OS and rack-level firmware and software", "source": "https://github.com/oxidecomputer/hubris"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://github.com/denoland/deno"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy service mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "Shopify", "use": "YJIT, the Ruby JIT compiler", "source": "https://shopify.engineering/ruby-yjit-is-production-ready"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Symbolicator and native crash processing", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/symbolicator"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and infrastructure", "source": "https://github.com/EmbarkStudios"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB 3 time-series database engine", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/the-plan-for-influxdb-3-0-open-source/"},
  {"company": "PingCAP", "use": "TiKV distributed key-value storage engine", "source": "https://github.com/tikv/tikv"},
  {"company": "Parity Technologies", "use": "Polkadot and Substrate blockchain node software", "source": "https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk"},
  {"company": "Solana Labs", "use": "Solana blockchain validator", "source": "https://github.com/solana-labs/solana"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "uv and Ruff Python tooling", "source": "https://github.com/astral-sh/uv"},
  {"company": "Mullvad VPN", "use": "VPN client daemon and apps", "source": "https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app"},
  {"company": "Warp", "use": "GPU-rendered terminal application", "source": "https://github.com/warpdotdev/Warp"},
  {"company": "Zed Industries", "use": "Zed collaborative code editor", "source": "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed"},
  {"company": "Neon", "use": "Serverless Postgres storage and compute layer", "source": "https://github.com/neondatabase/neon"},
  {"company": "Meilisearch", "use": "Search engine", "source": "https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch"}
]
```
